exposure: umbilical cord blood flow parameters (peak systolic velocity/end diastolic velocity (S/D), pulse index (PI), resistance index (RI))
cohort: The study included 109 patients with gestational hypertension admitted from January 2020 to December 2023, divided into a control group (S/D < 3) and an observation group (S/D >= 3).
finding: Umbilical cord blood flow parameters, particularly RI and PI, are effective clinical indicators for assessing intrauterine fetal condition and predicting poor prognosis such as intrauterine fetal hypoxia and fetal growth restriction in pregnant women with gestational hypertension.
mod_finding: The incidence of cesarean section was significantly lower in the control group (S/D < 3) compared to the observation group (S/D >= 3).
